observations: Repeated escape attempts are the central action rather than a failure outside the story.
Olympian powers combine differently between attempts.
The official description emphasizes a story that unfolds through repeated play with a voiced cast.
inferences: A failed run can advance understanding and relationship context without being converted into a mechanical win.
Build variation strengthens replay when the player can compare familiar identities in new combinations.
limits: The official summary does not prove which retention layer causes enjoyment.
Economy pacing and dialogue exhaustion require long-duration play evidence.
